verdict.rationale: Lighthouse's first-party pages present case preparation as its core service: it handles petitions, maps accomplishments to criteria to build the case, and includes a dedicated case manager, attorney review, expedited case preparation and RFE responses. However, the specific end-to-end components named in the story are not individually documented. missing for 10: explicit mention of expert/support letter drafting, evidence binder assembly, form preparation, and the provider performing the actual USCIS filing, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider prepares the petition end to end — evidence binder, expert and support letters, forms, and filing — documented as its core service

citations.quote: Lighthouse handles the petitions, timelines, and compliance behind every hire
